description: Na₃B₆PO₁₃ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pnma space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to eight O atoms to form NaO₈ hexagonal bipyramids that share corners with two equivalent NaO₈ hexagonal bipyramids, corners with two equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with four equivalent BO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.57 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.44-2.65 Å. There are three inequivalent B sites. In the first B site, B is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of B-O bond distances ranging from 1.35-1.39 Å. In the second B site, B is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of B-O bond distances ranging from 1.34-1.39 Å. In the third B site, B is bonded to four O atoms to form BO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one BO₄ tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one PO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with two equivalent NaO₈ hexagonal bipyramids. There is one shorter (1.41 Å) and three longer (1.49 Å) B-O bond lengths. P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₈ hexagonal bipyramids and corners with two equivalent BO₄ tetrahedra. There are two shorter (1.50 Å) and two longer (1.58 Å) P-O bond lengths. There are eight inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to two Na and two B atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one B, and one P atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to one Na and two B atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to two Na and two B atoms. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to one Na and two B atoms. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one P atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one P atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and two equivalent B atoms.
